title: QCI & NSIC Sign 5-Year MoU to Connect ZED-Certified MSMEs to Global Mart
summary: Integrates MSME ZED Certification Scheme with MSME Global Mart for 6.5 crore MSMEs.

blocks.content: Integrates MSME ZED Certification Scheme with MSME Global Mart for 6.5 crore MSMEs.

items: Strategic Integration: Combines QCI accreditation with NSIC network to link ZED-certified MSMEs to MSME Global Mart.
Economic Impact: India's 6.5 crore MSMEs employ ~28 crore people and contribute ~30% of GDP.

blocks.title: Static Background & GK Context
blocks.summary: Quality Council of India (QCI) Chairman: Jaxay Shah | NSIC CMD: Dr. Subhransu Sekhar Acharya.

blocks.content: MSME GDP contribution (~30%) vs employment (~28 crore people).
